host.description: Register the string, math, collections, testing, and file catalog functions. Context t is Trace: int records int N, float records float %.15g, bool records bool true|false, hex records hex SPACE followed by lowercase hexadecimal bytes (two digits per byte, no decoding). bytes(string) decodes an even-length ASCII hexadecimal fixture literal to raw bytes, without recording a trace. test_temp_dir() returns a fresh per-vector directory for file cases. Strings, offsets and lengths are bytes. runtime_error_file requires RUN_HOST, the function/path prefix, and a nonempty OS reason while allowing localized diagnostics. runtime_error_exact requires RUN_HOST and equality of the complete message after removing only the SDK source-location prefix. test_long_path() creates nested directories under the per-vector temporary directory, returning an ordinary absolute UTF-8 path longer than 260 characters ending in résumé-文件-😀.bin; the runner uses native extended-length paths for Windows fixture setup and cleanup, but does not return the extended prefix. File error reasons must contain at least one non-whitespace character.
